    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pointBrick_of_cocycles

    Point–brick data from two independent cocycles #

    If V is a sincere brick off a vertex x, vanishing at x and respecting the cover, and the cocycles of a generating family of relations from V to the simple representation at x have dimension at least two (that is, dim Ext¹(V, S_x) ≥ 2), then PointBrick holds (pointBrick_of_cocycles). pointBrick_of_count is the special case of a count.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pointBrick_of_cocycles {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (F : FinQuiver.Ext.RelFam (pieceQuiver S) k) (hF : ∀ (r : Fin F.m), F.ρ r ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (relGens k S)) (hgen : relGens k S ⊆ ↑(TwoSidedIdeal.span (Set.range F.ρ))) (x : (pieceQuiver S).V) (V : Rep k (pieceQuiver S)) (finV : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), FiniteDimensional k ↑(V.obj i)) (hVx : Subsingleton ↑(V.obj x)) (brickV : ∀ (f : V ⟶ V), ∃ (c : k), ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.app i) = c • LinearMap.id) (hV : ∃ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), Nontrivial ↑(V.obj i)) (hsinc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), i ≠ x → Nontrivial ↑(V.obj i)) (hVc : RespectsCover V) (h2 : 2 ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(FinQuiver.Ext.cocycles F)) :
    PointBrick S
